canonical_population.deduplication: Every distinct source path is resolved and snapshotted; file compliance is deduplicated by dev:inode, while every resolved path contributes its full parent chain. Repeated observations with different identity/mode/owner are ERROR.
canonical_population.executables: Each observable non-kernel, non-zombie process contributes /proc/<pid>/exe. Deleted, non-absolute, inaccessible or non-regular executable identity is ERROR. The /proc/<pid>/exe object identity must equal the observed target dev:inode. Target text and object state are snapshotted and rechecked before verdict.
canonical_population.kernel_threads_and_zombies: A PID without exe is excluded only when status proves Kthread: 1 or zombie state Z, or, when status has no Kthread line, the validated /proc/<pid>/stat flags field (field 9, ASCII unsigned decimal) has PF_KTHREAD (0x00200000) set; a present Kthread line is authoritative and flags are then not consulted. Malformed flags or disappearance before the flags read is ERROR. Exclusion also requires that the same PID starttime is confirmed after classification; identity drift or disappearance is ERROR.
canonical_population.libraries: Every executable file-backed /proc/<pid>/maps mapping (x permission, absolute decoded pathname, nonzero inode) is admitted regardless of basename. The full maps row grammar (address range, perms, offset, device, inode, optional pathname) is validated. A non-executable mapping whose decoded pathname starts with anon_inode: is not file-backed and is skipped like [pseudo] mappings; an executable anon_inode: mapping is ERROR. Linux proc octal pathname escapes are decoded exactly; invalid escape, deleted mapping, inaccessible/non-regular target or ambiguous pathname is ERROR. For each admitted mapping, the maps-declared device major/minor and inode must equal the observed regular file target; mismatch is ERROR. Each included process must expose at least one executable file-backed mapping; completeness is evaluated per PID, not by a global library counter.
canonical_population.observation_fail_closed: Unreadable or malformed proc metadata/maps, malformed maps address/offset/device/inode fields, maps-declared dev:inode mismatch, incomplete per-PID mapping population, /proc/stat process-counter drift, PID-set/starttime drift, per-PID exe/maps drift, path-resolution drift, file or parent dev/inode/owner/mode/ctime drift, inaccessible target or incomplete parent traversal is ERROR; partial PASS is forbidden.
canonical_population.process_snapshot: Observation is bounded by the monotonic /proc/stat processes counter plus exact numeric PID->starttime snapshots. The counter is captured before PID enumeration and must remain unchanged after per-PID observation and after final rechecks; this closes transient process creation that could appear and disappear between PID snapshots. The numeric PID->starttime population is compared after per-PID observation and again after file/parent/process rechecks; any addition/removal/reuse is ERROR. For included PIDs, exe target/object identity and the complete parsed executable maps set are re-read and must remain exact; no-exe kernel-thread/zombie exclusions are reclassified before verdict. The per-PID stat reader validates the exact 52-field /proc/<pid>/stat layout: PID prefix must match the directory name, field separators are single ASCII spaces, the tail contains exactly fields 3-52, all numeric fields are ASCII signed decimal, and starttime is ASCII unsigned decimal; missing/empty/shifted fields are ERROR. If an observation ends with one of the adapter RETRY_REASONS (process population changed during CHECK), the whole observation is repeated, at most 3 attempts with a 1 s pause; VALUE is emitted only from one fully stable attempt, otherwise ERROR with the reason of the last attempt. File and parent changes are not retried.

comparison.acl_note: POSIX ACL named-user/group permissions are bounded by the group-class mask. Когда group-class имеет wx, mode alone не определяет actual principals, поэтому current v1 fail-closed возвращает ERROR вместо консервативного FAIL.
comparison.error: ERROR represents incomplete/ambiguous observation, including a parent directory whose group-class wx cannot be adjudicated from mode alone unless another definite violation already proves FAIL.
comparison.fail: VALUE/FAIL requires complete observation and at least one definite file violation, non-root-owner directory wx, or other-class directory wx violation.
comparison.file_rule: Exact source chmod go-w is represented as (mode & 0022) == 0 for every executable/library target.
comparison.parent_rule: Для directory-entry write access требуется одновременно write+search (execute) в применимом permission class. Доказанное non-root owner wx или other wx даёт VALUE/FAIL. Group-class wx само по себе не доказывает, какой непривилегированный principal получает доступ (owning-group membership / POSIX ACL semantics), поэтому при отсутствии уже доказанного нарушения даёт ERROR, а не false FAIL/PASS. Every directory from containing directory through / is checked.
comparison.pass: VALUE/PASS requires an unchanged /proc/stat processes counter across the bounded observation, stable PID->starttime snapshots, complete and stable per-PID executable file-backed mapping observation, stable exe/file/parent snapshots, at least one included process, and zero file/parent violations. A process may have zero distinct shared-library identities when its executable mappings contain no distinct library target.
comparison.snapshot_rule: Before PASS/FAIL, every observed source path must resolve to the same target and retain dev/inode/uid/gid/mode/ctime identity; every parent directory must retain the same dev/inode/uid/gid/mode/ctime identity. Every included PID must retain the same exe target/object identity and exact parsed executable maps set. Drift is ERROR.

donor_precedent: Pinned engineering donor supplied only the /proc executable/maps discovery idea and mode-based checks. Silent skips and parent exclusions are not carried into current product; donor is not normative authority.

error_reason_contract.branch_specific: Each independently distinguishable observation failure branch emits its own stable domain:reason code; unrelated failures must not collapse to one generic code.
